hints.title: Recursive Evaluation of Subtrees
hints.text: Leaf nodes represent base truth values 0 (false) and 1 (true).

hints.title: Boolean Operator Evaluation
hints.text: Non-leaf nodes contain operation 2 (boolean or) or 3 (boolean and) applied to left and right subtrees.

hints.title: Post-Order Tree Traversal
hints.text: Recursively evaluate left and right children, then combine the boolean results using the operator in the current node.

hints.title: Post-Order Traversal Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Each node is visited once in post-order traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tree operations cannot be computed without bottom-up evaluation of leaves.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursion stack depth is proportional to tree height.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes post-order traversal pattern for expression tree evaluation.
